title: A look at Bending Spoons' hiring process: the company, which owns Vimeo, AOL, and Evernote, received 800,000 job applications last year and made only 286 hires (Ben Cohen/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Ben Cohen / Wall Street Journal: A look at Bending Spoons' hiring process: the company, which owns Vimeo, AOL, and Evernote, received 800,000 job applications last year and made only 286 hires — Getting an offer from Bending Spoons, which owns AOL, has become harder than getting into Harvard
